The two ordinary reverse legs independently start at N and do not recreate an original ordinary or emergency withdrawal, composed round trip or profit.
wbtc_artifact_extension.runtime_gate: Saved artifact records two directions, Exact=0, RPC=0 and no quoted fallback. Builder behavior was checked in the original same-candidate review and was not rerun in this artifact extension.
wbtc_artifact_extension.natural_target_valuation: missing; spliced input does not satisfy it

reviewed_control_flow: Existing WETH constants and default selection remain intact; fixed cbBTC/WBTC selections do not become production admission allowlists.

Original observer binds canonical receipt/log identities, successful ordinary call and return amount, receiver, independent mint/transfer receipt, and successful withdrawal-payment subtree. Emergency withdrawal cannot satisfy an ordinary withdrawal.

Reference mint is assigned only after a deposit sample completes its positive and negative checks. A failed execution/control leaves the sample failed or incomplete; final four-sample/eight-control gates reject it.
Spliced success is labeled distinctly, natural target valuation remains missing, and reverse execution is explicitly a separate same-N leg.
limitations: This review rechecked main-owned saved cbBTC EVM evidence and the appended WBTC artifact; it did not execute RPC, EVM, simulation, build, live or signing.
WBTC was added by a focused offline artifact extension. Fresh default-WETH historical execution remains unreviewed; its source/fixture behavior was inspected/tested.
No original call-prestate restoration, composed round trip, natural valuation, complete loop, profitability, representative performance, adapter_fixed or merge-ready conclusion.

Runtime source fingerprint excludes test directories; this bounded review does not establish a tamper-proof transitive closure of all shared test helpers. Saved evidence remains within the trusted-producer boundary.
